subject.title: Feature request: Mid-stream message injection (soft steer)

question: Should OpenClaw implement true pause-or-abort soft steer beyond current runtime-boundary steering, or scope this tracker to landing the remaining active-run queue/admission fixes first?
rationale: The requested behavior changes core active-run lifecycle semantics across generation abort, tool execution, context injection, fallback, and session state, which needs maintainer product/runtime direction before implementation.

options.title: Keep tracker, refresh current fix path
options.body: Keep this issue open as the soft-steer product/runtime tracker and prioritize a refreshed PR 89238-style admission fix before deciding any deeper pause/resume lifecycle.

options.title: Limit to boundary steering
options.body: Document current model-boundary steering as the supported behavior and move true pause/resume soft steer to a separate product proposal.

options.title: Sponsor full soft steer
options.body: Accept the broader feature direction and ask for a design covering abort/resume semantics, backend compatibility, partial output, and regression proof before implementation.

recommendation.title: Keep tracker, refresh current fix path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open as the soft-steer product/runtime tracker and prioritize a refreshed PR 89238-style admission fix before deciding any deeper pause/resume lifecycle.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the maintainer replacement PR for active non-streaming steering and are tied to adjacent reply lifecycle changes that the decision must preserve.
